newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Sterling firm in Asia, Labour leads in exit poll.
newsitem.headline: Sterling firm in Asia, Labour leads in exit poll.

text.p: Sterling firmed in thin early Asian trading after two exit polls pointed to a massive win by the New Labour party in the U.K. general election.
A poll by the BBC gave Labour 49 percent of the vote and the incumbent Conservative Party just 29 percent, while an ITN exit poll projected a huge 159 seat majority for Labour.

"There's relief it's all over and we clearly don't have a hung parliament, which was everyone's nightmare," said a U.K. bank dealer here. By 7.25 am (2125 GMT) the pound had quietly firmed to 2.8010/20 marks and $1.6280/90 from 2.7970/80 and $1.6253/60 ahead of the polls. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373 1800
